title: dbt Power User 'NoneType' has no attribute 'find_generate_macro_by_name'
answer:
I faced a similar issue after changing my source data from one file to another. I had a generic source file and then started creating one source file for each source.

What worked for me is:

1 - dbt clean

2 - dbt deps

3 - Reload VS Code window

The first 2 allowed me to dbt run -s table without issue. And the 3rd allowed be to run the query on VS Code.
